mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock (warehouse_id, item_id, batch_id, location_id, quantity, updated_at) VALUES (#{warehouseId}, #{itemId}, #{batchId}, #{locationId}, #{quantity}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id, warehouse_id, item_id, batch_id, location_id, quantity, pre_allocated_qty, updated_at FROM stock WHERE warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND item_id = #{itemId} AND location_id = #{locationId} AND batch_id <> 0 AND quantity > 0 AND quantity - pre_allocated_qty > 0 AND NOT frozen ORDER BY id
